snippet.title: [NP] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D2 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko Finals jari chha!

PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko ultimate stage Finals ko Day 2 aaja Paris ma suru hudai chha! Dherai dinko fierce competition pachi, world ka top 16 teams le glory, legacy ra $3,000,000 prize pool ko sabai bhanda thulo hissa ko lagi ladna aafno thau secure gareka chan.

Yo nai ho tyo moment jasko lagi harek team le grind gareko thiyo, ra euta din ko battle pahilai sakisakeko chha. Group Stage ka best teams ra Survival Stage bata survive gareka teams aba feri ekpatak barsako sabai bhanda intense showdown ma head-to-head bhidnechan. Tin din, SMASH RULE, ra euta champion.

Journey aaja jhan uchai ma pugchha, kina bhane antim ma trophy uthaera PUBG MOBILE history ma aafno naam lekhaune team keval euta matra hunechha. Finals ko Day 2 suru Vayo!

🔥SMASH RULE kasari kaam garchha?
Finals ko Day 2 pachi, Match Point Threshold #1 ranked team ko points +10 ma set garincha. Yo threshold reach gareko team le tyaspachi ko kunai match jitnu parchha trophy claim garna. Threshold reach gareko tei match jitda championship jitidaina. Yedi Match 18 samma kunai team le SMASH RULE anusaar title secure garna sakena bhane, standard rules anusaar sabai bhanda dherai total points bhayeko team champion hunechha.

🔥 Kina tapaile PMWC at EWC 26 miss garnu hudaina:

- Paris ma world ko top PUBG MOBILE teams haru glory ko lagi battle gareko hernuhos!
- Pratyek match le race ma impact parne high-stakes action ko experience garnuhos!
- Aafno favorite region ra team lai $3,000,000 ra crown ko lagi cheer garnuhos!
- Finals ma exciting SMASH RULE format!

Survival Stage: August 11–12

Filmed for IMAX

snippet.title: Yabesh Thapa - Tadha ft. Oshin Karki | OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO
snippet.description:
I made Tadha almost four years ago and was obsessed with the idea, but I felt stuck at the same time. I knew I wanted to write a song that justifies loving someone from a distance, because the people we love can't always be by our side. Even though the song is called Tadha and carries a certain sadness, I wanted it to feel warm, fun, and full of love, but I just couldn't figure out how to finish it. It wasn't until I started working on GhaamChhaya that I finally found the motivation to complete it. Oshin graced the song with her beautiful voice, making it even more special. Fast forward a couple of years, we finally got to make a fun video for Tadha, and we hope you guys enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it !

This one is for all the tadha batai maya garne mayalus !

Written, Composed, and Performed by Yabesh Thapa & Oshin Karki

This stream provides a real-time map-only view, allowing you to track team rotations, zone shifts, and strategic movements as they unfold.

This is it the last matches of PMWC at EWC 26. The world’s best 16 teams have given everything, but only one will lift the trophy and take home the lion’s share of the $3,000,000 prize pool. Every rotation, every zone, and every elimination today could change the outcome of the entire championship because, now a team can win with SMASH RULE.

🔥 How does SMASH RULE work? 
On the last day of the PMWC at EWC 26 Finals, we have the Match Point Threshold! In Overall Ranking after 12th match, #1 ranked team’s points +10. Any team that hits this must then win a later match to claim the trophy winning the same match where they reach the threshold doesn’t bring the championship. If no team secures the title via SMASH Rule by Match 18, the team with the highest total points wins under standard rules.

🔥 Why You Can't Miss PMWC at EWC 26:
- Witness the world's top PUBG MOBILE teams battle for glory in Paris!
- Experience high-stakes action with every match impacting the race.
- Cheer for your favorite region and team as they chase the $3,000,000 and a crown!
- Exciting SMASH RULE format in Finals!

snippet.title: Nazar Lagi Official Music Video | Akanksha Choudhary | Goldie Sohel | Asees Kaur | Noor | New Music
snippet.description:
Some love stories aren't meant to end because love fades. They end because fate has other plans. Nazar Lagi featuring Akanksha Choudhary is a heartbreak ballad by Goldie Sohel and Asees Kaur that captures the silent ache of two hearts deeply in love, yet separated by circumstances beyond their control. It is a story of longing, memories that refuse to fade, and the unbearable pain of watching love slip away despite never wanting to let go.

Singers - Goldie Sohel & Asees Kaur 
Music Composer  - Goldie Sohel 
Lyrics - Noor

snippet.title: Sheetal | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Sheetal - a sweet summer love story of “Ritu” and “Mausam”. 

Ritu arrives in a new city and meets Mausam, and they fall into a whirlwind romance that feels like it could last forever. But fate had other plans. When Ritu returns to find him, she is met with the cold truth of Mausam’s passing.

He may have left the world, but the feeling of him—the laughter in the ride, the warmth of his hand, the shade he offered in her hottest moments—refuses to fade. This video is a meditation on how the shortest chapters often leave the deepest imprints. Some loves don't need a lifetime to become eternal; they just need to be real.


Starring : Muskan Gurung, Cheyozen

snippet.title: You’re My Beautiful Reason ❤️ | Romantic Love Song Duet | Emotional Love Ballad
snippet.description:
You’re My Beautiful Reason is a deeply emotional romantic duet about finding the one person who makes life feel complete. ❤️

A love that brings color back to your world, gives you strength through every storm, and turns ordinary moments into memories you never want to lose.

✨ “If forever has a meaning, it’s growing old with you…”

This heartfelt male and female duet is for everyone who has found someone they want beside them through every season of life.

Perfect for romantic evenings, weddings, slow dances, anniversaries, couples, love playlists, or simply closing your eyes and thinking about the person who means everything to you.

🎧 Listen with headphones and let the music speak to your heart.

Soft Emotion Music
Music for love, memories, and the moments that stay forever. ❤️

snippet.title: LEGACY EP 09 | REDEMPTION ROUND | @raftaarmusic x @KRSNAOfficial
snippet.description:
The fight for redemption begins!
For the artists on the edge of elimination, this is their chance to fight their way back.

In Episode 9, they return to the LEGACY Arena and perform before a live audience, knowing that one performance could decide whether their journey continues or ends here.
There is no room to hold back. They have to own the stage, prove why they still belong in the competition and earn another chance to stay in LEGACY.

Who will rise when it matters most and earn their redemption?


New Episodes Every Tuesday & Friday at 7 PM only on Hindi Zee 5
Watch Every Thursday & Sunday at 12 PM only on YouTube - Kalamkaar

0:00 Intro
0:24 Introduction & Raghav Juyal entry
4:55 KNSS
10:25 Farhan Khan Performance
21:45 Gamak
29:45 Jordindian entry
34:55 Chief
43:35 Vanither
52:53 Rap ID
59:25 Dean
1:06:36 See Off Guest Judges
1:08:19 Eliminations
1:10:10 Outro

Sar pe baabe ka hand 
Joh kaam kiye woh grand 
Yaa toh banger yaa phir _____

Ho duniya horahi fan
Yaa toh banger yaa phir ban

Double R to shauk se rakhi hai
Par aaj bhi ghar pe maruti
Kabhi private jet kabhi indigo

Are baby understand 
Ab naam bana hai brand
Jab chahe karte land
Ya to banger ya phir _____

Naa koi team naa koi plan
Ho duniya horahi fan
Yaa toh banger yaa phir ban
 
Its your boy Badshah

snippet.title: I Built Minecraft's Most Advanced Civilization
snippet.description:
After being banished from my kingdom, I ran hundreds of thousands of blocks out to create a new civilization... A civilization that would one day be strong enough to defeat my biggest enemy, Saparata. This is How I Built Minecraft's Most Advanced Civilization. 

Unstable SMP:
➜ ‪  ‪    @FlameFragsMC 
➜       @Spokeishere 
➜     ‪‪  @wemmbumc 
➜       @ParrotX2 

Like ParrotX2 and his Unstable SMP series, where he is escaping Paragon / Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison, or got hunted by a Minecraft Player who doesn't exist. This is a new and original Minecraft idea like HermitCraft or Lifesteal with Wemmbu, FlameFrags, or Spoke. Survival is harder than Hardcore Minecraft because PVP is on.

People in this video: @saparata @ClownPierce @HoraceMinecraft 

Yo thank you to all the people in trusted who helped with the montage you guys are goated. 

This is a video on the Unstable Universe: a staged Minecraft server where ParrotX2, Wemmbu, Spoke, and FlameFrags tell stories in Minecraft.

snippet.description:

📌This is the moment when someone is gone, yet their presence still lingers in every corner of the room.
It is a song about choosing dignity over longing, accepting the tears without surrendering to them, and reclaiming the right to decide what stays, what is released, and where life goes next. 
Healing does not mean you never bend. It means that, even through the pain, you keep walking until your life belongs to you again.


Evening leaning on the walls
Shadows stretching down the halls
Your keys still waited by the door
For hands that won’t come back once more..

One empty hook beside the frame
The smallest things still keep your name
Some people fit beneath your skin
That doesn't mean you let them in
Don’t mistake my calm for torn,
I know exactly what went wrong

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes, I decide this life is mine. 
I may bend, but I’ll be fine. 

Your number lives inside my phone
Like a road that leads back home
I nearly sent you something small
But it wouldn’t change, a thing at all

I watch the evening change the room
Making space where you once moved
And the silence starts to sound
Like my voice comes back around
Some people settle in your bones
Then leave you colder than alone. 

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save. 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes I decide this life is mine
I may bend, but I’ll be fine

Some goodbyes show you who you are
When you stop hiding every scar
Even if I melt into tears
I’ll keep walking through my fears.

bn.title: আমরা মাইনক্রাফটে গোপন ভিলেজার শহর খুঁজে পেয়েছি...
bn.description:
মিঃ ডারবিন ও ক্যারিডিপাই সম্পূর্ণ নতুন একটি গল্প নিয়ে ফিরে এসেছেন!

এই পর্বে, আমরা ক্যারিডিপাই-এর পুরোনো কন্টেন্টের কিছু মুহূর্ত একত্রিত করে সেগুলোকে নতুনভাবে সম্পাদিত একটি গল্প বলার অভিজ্ঞতায় রূপান্তরিত করেছি।

একটি ভিন্ন দেখার অভিজ্ঞতা তৈরি করার জন্য, ভিডিওটিকে একটি নতুন কাহিনী, দৃশ্যের বিন্যাস, গতি, ট্রানজিশন, ইন্ট্রো, আউটরো এবং অতিরিক্ত সৃজনশীল সম্পাদনার মাধ্যমে ব্যাপকভাবে পুনরায় সম্পাদনা ও পুনর্গঠন করা হয়েছে।

🎬 ক্রেডিট

মূল নির্মাতা: ক্যারিডিপাই
সমস্ত মূল ফুটেজ এবং চরিত্র তাদের নিজ নিজ নির্মাতাদের সম্পত্তি।

এই ভিডিওটি একটি সম্পাদিত গল্প বলা/বিনোদনমূলক কাজ হিসেবে উপস্থাপন করা হয়েছে। এর উদ্দেশ্য হলো মূল ভিডিওগুলো কেবল পুনরায় আপলোড না করে, একটি নতুন আখ্যান কাঠামো এবং সৃজনশীল উপস্থাপনা যোগ করা।

দেখার জন্য ধন্যবাদ ❤️

যদি গল্পটি আপনার ভালো লেগে থাকে, তাহলে অবশ্যই লাইক 👍 করুন, সাবস্ক্রাইব 🔔 করুন এবং ভিডিওটি আপনার বন্ধুদের সাথে শেয়ার করুন!

মিঃ ডারবিনের আরও গল্প, অ্যাডভেঞ্চার এবং মাইনক্রাফট-ধাঁচের বিনোদন শীঘ্রই আসছে।

snippet.description:

I am Khaleel Present : Roblox Dangerous Mountain Biking 🚵‍♂️🌋 | Part 2 — Can We FINALLY Beat the Mountain?

Welcome back to Roblox Dangerous Mountain Biking – Part 2! 🚵‍♂️🔥

In Part 1, Khaleel, Motu, and Doraemon managed to reach the checkpoint, but they couldn't complete the game! 😱 Today, they're back for Part 2, and this time the goal is simple — CLEAR THE ENTIRE GAME! 🏆

But the mountains are even more dangerous than before! ❄️🌋🔥 From freezing snowy paths and deadly lava mountains to burning roads and terrifying bridges, one wrong move could send us straight back to the beginning! 💀😂

🚵 Khaleel, Motu & Doraemon are back!
🏁 Continue from the checkpoint
❄️ Survive freezing mountain roads
🌋 Cross dangerous lava-filled mountains
🔥 Ride through areas surrounded by fire
🌉 Balance across dangerous bridges
💥 Avoid deadly obstacles and crashes
🏆 Reach the final finish line
😂 Watch Motu, Doraemon & Khaleel's crazy bike moments

This isn't just a mountain bike race anymore — it's a challenge to see if all three of us can actually finish the game! 😱

After reaching the checkpoint in Part 1, can Khaleel, Motu, and Doraemon finally make it to the end and WIN the entire game? Or will the dangerous mountains defeat them again? 🚵‍♂️💀

🔥 WATCH UNTIL THE END TO FIND OUT WHO WINS!

🚵 Roblox Dangerous Mountain Biking Features

❄️ Extreme snowy mountains
🌋 Dangerous lava mountains
🔥 Fire-filled mountain paths
🌉 Difficult bridges and obstacles
🚵 Crazy bike racing challenges
🏆 Checkpoints and challenging levels
👥 Multiplayer racing with friends
😂 Funny fails, crashes & unexpected moments
